name: cloud-tools
description: Multi-cloud cost, inventory and waste analysis for agents: what you spend by service, region and account, and what is idle, oversized, previous-generation, unattached or an unused commitment. AWS, GCP, Cloudflare and OVH.

plugins.name: cloud-tools
plugins.description: A skill that teaches an agent to answer cloud spend and waste questions against a real account, and to read a zero total correctly. Bundles the cloud-tools MCP server so install wires everything in one step.
